meta.description: [FR] Interventional cardiologist practising at Geitaoui and Karantina hospitals in Beirut. Consultations, cardiac testing, coronary angiography and angioplasty.

hero.heading: [FR] Cardiology care in Beirut, from consultation to intervention
hero.subheading: [FR] Dr Jean Obeid sees patients at Geitaoui and Karantina hospitals. If you are worried about your heart, or a parent's, you can reach the clinic directly.

contact.title: [FR] Contact and appointments
contact.intro: [FR] Appointments are arranged by the clinic secretary. Call or send a WhatsApp message for the fastest response, or send a request below and she will come back to you.
